spans.s:
Aptote noun.
The face, the mouth.

n. (-नं)
A cemetery, a place where dead bodies are burnt or buried.
E.
श्म substituted for शव a corpse, and शान for शयन place of repose.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
A ghost, a gole, a sprite, male or female, abiding in cemeteries, &c.
E.
श्मशान a cemetery, and वासिन् who abides; also श्मशाननिवासिन्, श्मशानवर्त्तिन्, &c.

MAHĀDEVA.
2

A ghost.
E.
श्मशान a cemetery, and वेश्मन् abode.

n. (-श्रु)
The beard.
E.
श्मन् for मुख the face, श्रि to serve, Uṇādi aff. डुन्, form irr.; also श्मश्रुन्.

f. (-खी)
A woman with a beard.
E.
श्मश्रु a beard, and मुख the face, ङीष् fem. aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Bearded, having a beard.
E.
श्मश्रु, and लच् aff.

m. (-कः)
A barber.
E.
श्मश्रु, and वर्द्धक who cuts.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Being as if bearded, having something like a beard.
E.
श्मश्रु used as a verb, शानच् aff.

ind.
1 An expletive.
2 A particle which added to verbs in the present tense gives them a past sense, as हन्तिस्मरावणंरामः RĀMA killed (instead of kills) RĀVAṆA.
E.
षो to end or destroy, ङ्म aff., or ष्मिङ to smile, aff. ड.

m. (-यः)
1 Pride, arrogance.
2 Surprise, astonishment.
E.
स्मि to smile, अच् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 KĀMADEVA, the deity of love.
2 Recollection.
E.
स्मृ to remember, अच् aff.

n. (-र्म्म)
Lasciviousness, wanton pleasures.
E.
स्मर, and कर्म्मन् act.

mf. (-पकः-पिका)
Pudendum muliebre.
E.
स्मर KĀMA, कूप a well, and कन् aff. of comparison.

m. (-रुः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
स्मर love, गुरु the spiritual or natural father.

n. (-हं)
The vulva.
E.
स्मर KĀMA, and गृह mansion.

n. (-त्रं)
The clitoris.
E.
स्मर love, च्छत्र an umbrella.

n. (-णं)
1 Recollecting, remembering, memory, recollection
2 Regretting, remembering with regret.
E.
स्मृ to remember, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-णं)
Calling to mind, reminding, causing to remember.
E.
स्मृ to remember, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

m. (-कः)
A turtle, a tortoise.
E.
स्मरण memory, अपत्य offspring, and तर्पक who pleases.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Fit or proper to be remembered.
E.
स्मृ to remember, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्)
Remembering, recollecting, considering.
E.
स्मृ to remember, शतृ aff.

m. (-जः)
1 Any musical instrument.
2 The penis.
3 A sort of fabulous fish or marine monster, the emblem of KĀMADEVA.
n. (-जं)
The vulva.
f. (-जा)
A bright moonlight night.
E.
स्मर KĀMA, and ध्वज emblem.

f. (-या)
RATI, the wife of KĀMA.
E.
स्मर the deity of love, and प्रिया wife.

n. (-रं)
Pudendum muliebre.
E.
स्मर love, and मन्दिर abode.

m. (-हः)
Passion, love.
E.
स्मर, and मोह fascination.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Overcome by love or passion.
E.
स्मर, and मोहित bewildered.

f. (-नी)
The Sārika, (Turdus salica,) or Maina, (Gracula religiosa.)
E.
स्मर love, लेखनी a pen, a writing.

m. (-भः)
ANIRUDDHA.
E.
स्मर KĀMA, and वल्लभ beloved.

f. (-का)
A harlot.
E.
स्मर love, वीथि a shop, कन् aff.

m. (-खः)
The moon.
E.
स्मर CUPID, and सख a friend.

m. (-म्भः)
The penis.
E.
स्मर CUPID, and स्तम्भ post.

m. (-र्य्यः)
An ass.
E.
स्मर KĀMA, and स्मर्य्य to be remembered.

m. (-रः)
ŚIVA.
E.
स्मर the deity of love, and हर destroying.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
In love.
E.
स्मर, and आकुल overcome; also स्मराकुलित.

n. (-रं)
The vulva.
E.
स्मर love, आगार abode.

m. (-शः)
1 A finger nail.
2 A lover, a lecher.
E.
स्मर love, and अङ्कुश a goad.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Overcome with love or passion.
E.
स्मर, and आतुर perplexed.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Infatuated with love.
E.
स्मर, and अन्ध blind.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
Overcome or agitated by love.
E.
स्मर, and आर्त्त pained.

m. (-वः)
Saliva.
E.
स्मर love, आसव wine.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Devoted to love.
E.
स्मर, and उत्सुक fond of.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
Fit or proper to be remembered.
E.
स्मृ to remember, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Being remembered.
E.
स्मृ to remember, pass. v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Called to memory, caused to remember.
E.
स्मृ to remember, causal v., क्त aff.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ती-र्त्तं)
1 Legal, canonical, according to the doctrines of the Smṛtis or inspired codes of law.
2 Following or professing the doctrine of the law books.
3 Memorial, relating to memory.
4 Within memory, what may be remembered.
m. (-र्त्तः)
A Brahman following the revealed law.
E.
स्मृति law collectively, and अण् aff. of reference, &c.

m. (-लः)
Time to which memory may extend; according to the jurists, as far as a century.
E.
स्मार्त्त, and काल time.
